schema.unchanged: Nothing to change in your database.
schema.invalid: Your database schema is not valid, so it was not applied. Fix vibe.schema.json and publish again.
schema.needsConfirmation: This update would delete data. Nothing was changed in your database until you confirm.
schema.failed: Could not update your database. Please try again.
schema.confirmIntro: Publishing this update will permanently change your live database. This cannot be undone:
schema.confirmTypeHint: To confirm, type DELETE or one of these table names: {names}

kind.drop_table: Table {table} will be deleted with all its rows
kind.drop_column: Column {column} of table {table} will be deleted with its data
kind.change_type: Column {column} of table {table} will change type; values that do not fit may be lost
kind.make_required: Column {column} of table {table} will become required; rows without a value will be affected

secrets.title: API keys
secrets.inputHint: Keys are write-only: once saved, a key is never shown again. Pasting a new one replaces it.

error.signIn: Your session expired. Sign in again to manage keys.
error.forbidden: Only the creator of this app can manage its keys.
error.notFound: This project could not be found.
error.unavailable: The key service had a problem, so the change may not have taken effect. Try again in a moment.
error.notSetUp: Key storage is not available yet.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.invalid: That key contains characters that are not allowed. Paste it again without line breaks.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and paste the key again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Paste the key again to retry.
error.stripePublishable: That is a publishable key (pk_). Paste the secret key (sk_ or rk_) instead.
error.stripeWebhookFormat: That does not look like a webhook signing secret. It should start with whsec_.
error.stripeKeyFormat: That does not look like a Stripe secret key. It should start with sk_ or rk_ (for example sk_test_...).

pay.secretKeyHelp: Your Stripe secret key. It starts with sk_ or rk_ (test keys start with sk_test_). Never use the publishable key (pk_).
pay.webhookSecretHelp: The signing secret of the webhook endpoint you create in Stripe. It starts with whsec_.
pay.testFirst: Use Stripe test keys first (they start with sk_test_). Switch to live keys only when you are ready to take real payments. Saved keys are write-only, so this panel cannot tell you which mode a saved key is in.
pay.webhookUrlLabel: In Stripe (Developers > Webhooks), add an endpoint with this URL, then paste its signing secret below:
pay.webhookUrlPending: Preview or publish your app to get its webhook URL.
